problem: Find the real part of the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}2-3\text{i} & 2\text{i} \\ 7 & -9+4\text{i}\end{aligned}].$

feedback.problem: Find the real part of the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}-2+3\text{i} & -5+2\text{i} \\ 6-7\text{i} & 4-9\text{i}\end{aligned}].$
feedback.worked_solution:
For the given matrix $A,$ we have that

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}-2+3\text{i} & -5+2\text{i} \\ 6-7\text{i} & 4-9\text{i}\end{aligned}] \\  & ={{[\begin{aligned}-2 & -5 \\ 6 & 4\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{\text{Re}(A)}+\text{i}{{[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 \\ -7 & -9\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{\text{Im}(A)}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $\text{Re}(A)=[\begin{aligned}-2 & -5 \\ 6 & 4\end{aligned}].$
